name: Problem mode: the system solves the owner's book problems end to end (the problem text is the user message, the engines compute)
status: running; an engineering loop on development samples, never a sealed test
owner_request: Owner 2026-10-02: 'Focus on this — we must make it solve problems, otherwise it's useless.' Arithmetic over aggregates ('how many more', 'fewest steps') belongs here.
hypothesis: With exact decimal arithmetic in session rules, same-turn conversation entities and a problem mode in the formalizers, the system answers a substantial share of the book problems from batch 1's 0/100 (LocalLLMStepByStep B, Qwen3-4B): the 27B formalizer (remote-direct, LocalLLMDirect on the openference Qwen3.8 27b; CodingAgent when omp works with it) on the computational families (math, decompose, adult quantities, world formulas), the 4B step-by-step with problem questions on a smaller share. Qualitative families (critical thinking, analogy, abduction, open text answers) stay honest unknowns.
data: datasets_sources/books/eval/items.jsonl (7000 items of 7 books, extracted by tools/eval/books/extract.mjs). Loops use small stratified random samples (tools/eval/books/sample.mjs, 10 to 20 items, a fresh seed each loop, items marked seen); a batch of 100 is measured only when the small samples stop showing new failure classes.
arms: remote-direct: LocalLLMDirect on Qwen3.8 27b through LLMAPIProvider (openference)
coding-agent: CodingAgent through omp with llmapiprovider/Qwen3.8 27b
steps: LocalLLMStepByStep method B with Qwen3-4B-Instruct Q4_K_M and the problem questions
direct: Qwen3-4B answering directly (the batch-1 baseline)
metrics: per book: correct / wrong / honest unknown / invalid / failed (tools/eval/books/score.mjs: numbers with 0.5% tolerance, yes/no polarity, entity strings; an LLM judge for the rest)
how much the engine did: proof facts, rules used, aggregates, constraint solving (tools/eval/books/attribution.mjs)
stopping: A loop stops early when its first 5 items show the same infrastructure failure (fix first). A failure class is closed when a generic fix removes it on a fresh sample. The batch of 100 is run when two consecutive small samples show no new failure class.
